what: A cylindrical boss of radius 3 mm and height 17 mm sits on a 12 × 12 × 9 mm plate spanning −9 ≤ x ≤ 3. The 2 mm round follows one closed edge whose seam is on the tangent plane x = 3. The round ends flush with that plane.

expected.method: With R = 3 mm and d = 2 mm, the exact circular section has radius r = R + d − d sin θ at z = d(1 − cos θ), θ from 0 to π/2. Integrate the area with dz = d sin θ dθ. The surviving disk area is the mean of the complete disk and the symmetric strip |x| ≤ R, of area 2(R sqrt(r²−R²) + r² asin(R/r)). Add the integral of its excess over πR² to 12·12·9 + 17πR² mm³.
